name: How long does a typical door installation take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical door installation take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a door installation depends on the type of door and the complexity of the project. A standard interior door replacement can often be completed within a few hours. However, installing an exterior entry door, especially if it requires frame adjustments, sill replacement, or creating a new opening, might take a full day or longer. Projects involving multiple doors or custom installations will naturally extend the timeline. We provide an estimated timeline during the initial consultation, allowing you to plan accordingly.
acceptedAnswer.description: Standard interior door installation can take a few hours, while complex exterior or custom installations might take a full day or longer depending on project scope.
